what_improved: Generic Modelling Loop is implemented end-to-end.
Persistence rotation in update_scenario_last_run_summary is minimal and scoped.
Other replay_metadata keys are preserved across writes.
Factory project run summary output is byte-identical to pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
Exploratory banner is required for generic_solar / generic_wind.
10 KPI delta list is documented and tested.
what_remains_exploratory: Generic Solar remains exploratory and unvalidated.
Generic Wind remains exploratory and unvalidated.
Generic defaults are illustrative until validated by reference models.
Exploratory banner must remain in place for generic_solar / generic_wind deltas until validated.
what_remains_unvalidated: Generic Solar output is not Excel-parity validated against a reference solar model.
Generic Wind output is not Excel-parity validated against a reference wind model.
Generic Solar / Wind defaults are not market-validated assumptions.
What Changed deltas are explanatory; they are not guaranteed accuracy claims.
3-way / 4-way compare is internal functionality, not model validation.
Multi-compare picker is UI / navigation only, not model validation.
Export / download pack is internal artifact generation, not bankability.
No paid pilot has been authorized.
No customer reference has been made.

Phase 24-H closure testability review (PR #582) on main.

Phase 25B-3 exploratory banner: required for generic_solar / generic_wind.
B1, B11, B19, B22, B35, B36, B37, B38, B39, B40 B-track governance artifacts on main.

global_notes: The Generic Modelling / Scenario Loop arc is internal functionality. It is not external validation. It is not bankability. It is not a market-validated generic template.
Generic Solar and Generic Wind remain exploratory and unvalidated. Generic defaults are illustrative until validated by reference models.
The scenario compare, the export / download pack, and the What Changed delta panel are internal functionality — not model validation, not bankability, not investment advice.
Agent B does not implement code. Agent A implements code, tests, and the persistence rotation. Agent B records the B-track governance state for the Generic Modelling / Scenario Loop arc.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
